# Tasks

## 1. Pull-request guidance and the deliverable record

- [x] 1.1 Add a failing test that a temporary init installs a Cursor factory rule and a factory-run skill which name `idefactory pr open`, `idefactory pr comment`, and `idefactory pr capture` as the only legal pull-request steps, say the agent never merges, and say `sync-tasks`, `run`, `approve`, `complete`, `verify`, `ci scaffold`, and archive or spec sync run only after the human asks. The installed text does not name the Cursor pull-request tool or `gh pr create` as a legal step. Verify the test fails with `node --test test/pr-guidance.test.mjs` before the template edit. Then add that text to `templates/skills/factory-coordinator/SKILL.md`, `templates/skills/factory-run/SKILL.md`, `templates/skills/factory-openspec/SKILL.md`, `templates/skills/factory-governance/SKILL.md`, `templates/cursor/rules/factory.mdc`, `templates/cline/rules/factory.md`, and `templates/copilot/factory.agent.md`. Verify the same test passes.
  - Installed factory guidance allows only the three pull-request commands, never merges, and waits for the human before the named commands.
  factory:
    kind: general
    risk: medium
    roles: [engineer, reviewer, scribe]
    checks: [unit]
    verificationProfile: frontend-low
    securityProfile: dependency-basic
    dependencies: []

- [x] 1.2 Add a failing test that `isDeliverableChange` is false when `.factory/pull-requests/<change>.json` is missing, when the pull request number or URL is absent, and when the branch is not `factory/<change>`. It is true for a record with that branch, a positive pull request number, and a non-empty URL. The same test shows the stage 1 exit check fails a change when the predicate is false and accepts the record check when the predicate is true. Verify the test fails with `node --test test/pr-deliverable.test.mjs` before the predicate exists. Then add `isDeliverableChange` beside `readPullRequestRecord` in `src/lib/pull-request.mjs`, and state in the factory-openspec and factory-coordinator templates that archive runs this check first and does not move the change when it is false. Verify `node --test test/pr-deliverable.test.mjs` and `node --test test/pull-request-outer-loop.test.mjs` pass.
  - Archive and the stage 1 exit test use one predicate, and a change without a `pr open` record is not deliverable.

## Workflow follow-up

- Jason approves this change before it is executable. Do not sync tasks until then.
- Open the pull request for this change with `idefactory pr open` on `factory/require-pr-open-for-delivery`.
- A cloud agent needs a Cursor environment runtime secret named `GH_TOKEN` before `pr open`, `pr comment`, and `pr capture`. The secret is a fine-grained personal access token for this repository only: contents read and write, pull requests read and write, and metadata read. The Cursor GitHub App token is not sufficient. Do not write the token value into the repository. Later Azure DevOps and Zoho credentials are runtime secrets in the same way, not committed files.
- Do not merge.
